title: Bora Employer Pipeline Job Analysis Result
description: First vertical-slice structured output of analyze_job: requirements, evidence matches, gaps/unknowns, and inspectable lane/decision. Not a résumé patch and not a hire-probability score.

extraction_mode.description: V1 requires a structured extraction payload. This milestone does not call paid model APIs.

role_status.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied role freshness classification (schemas/job.schema.json, Blueprint Section 20/21), passed through unchanged. Null when not supplied by the caller -- never fabricated as VERIFIED_LIVE.

source_verification_status.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied direct-source verification axis (schemas/job.schema.json, Blueprint Section 19), passed through unchanged and independently of role_status. Null when not supplied.

date_last_verified.description: POSTING_STATE_DECISION_WIRING_V1: caller-supplied most-recent verification date, passed through unchanged. No freshness-threshold or date-arithmetic logic is applied to it. Null when not supplied.
